description.value: McDonald's is a globally recognized fast-food chain offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, wraps, breakfast items, and McCafé coffee beverages. This North Vancouver location on Lougheed Highway includes drive-through and takeout service. It sits along a major arterial corridor that touring cyclists may pass through when navigating the North Shore.
